We take all disputes seriously and are committed to complying with the Fair Debt Collection Practices Act (FDCPA) and Arizona state law. We will investigate your concerns regarding the validation of the debt and provide a response as soon as possible.

Please note that you have the right to dispute this debt further if you believe it is inaccurate or if you have any additional information regarding the account. We encourage you to review the validation notice carefully and contact us if you have any questions or concerns.
